## ♿ Accessibility Checklist
- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Used appropriate tags for elements.
- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: Added labels to icon-only buttons and complex components.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: Verified that all new features are keyboard-accessible.
- [ ] **Focus States**: Ensured visible focus indicators are present.
- [ ] **Color Contrast**: Checked that text and UI elements meet contrast standards.
- [ ] **Alt Text**: Added descriptive alt text for new images.
